title: [bug] Statsig adapter not included in current release
body: Currently only the `getProvider` function is included in the `@flags-sdk/statsig` module. The adapter looks like it was merged, but doesn't seem to be included in the latest release?
author: erik-nilcoast

comments.body:
Yes, that's expected. Merging does not automatically cut a new release.

We have not released the new version yet as we're still preparing docs and other things for this release. The adapter should be available by the end of next week latest!
